pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered: HTTP 5xx rate spike in eu-west1
pagerbot: service=inference-gateway threshold=5xx_rate>3% window=1m current=7.2% triggered_by=error-rate-rule (pd_incident: PD-78901)
oncall-alice: acked PD-78901 — I'm on it. @sre-charlie @eng-runtime-dana fyi
sre-charlie: looking at metrics — spike started ~2m ago. 502s mostly from /v1/generate route to model:rw-large-4q
eng-runtime-dana: seeing increased backend timeouts to the serving pool. KV cache saturation + queue buildup on nodepool-gpu-b
oncall-alice: any customer-facing impact? cs-erin?
cs-erin: we have 2 support tickets about timeouts from an EU customer, minor but asking if we are aware. I'll prep a short note.
bob-sales: flagged for one enterprise trial that's mid-demo. keep me in the loop.
sre-charlie: running quick healthcheck: nodepool-gpu-b has 30% higher CPU steal and 40% increase in open connections. Autoretry rate from clients also increased.
eng-runtime-dana: suggest temporary routing to variant rw-large-4q-fallback (smaller memory profile) and increase worker replicas by +2 in eu-west1. also enable circuit-breaker to drop long tails at 10s.
oncall-alice: doing a routing policy change now: `redwoodctl route set inference-gateway --region eu-west1 --policy fallback:rw-large-4q-fallback`
oncall-alice: applying change...
pagerbot: deploybot: route update started by oncall-alice
pagerbot: deploybot: route update complete (rollout 100%)
sre-charlie: routing change applied. monitoring 30s.
eng-runtime-dana: scaling replica count: `k scale deployment serving-pool-gpu-b --replicas=10 --namespace=eu-west1` (was 8)
eng-runtime-dana: scaling command issued
pagerbot: k8s-bot: horizontal scale triggered by oncall-alice
sre-charlie: after routing + scale: 5xx rate dropped to 3.8% in 45s, latency P95 improved from 1.8s -> 1.1s
oncall-alice: still above alert threshold. I'll enable request-level prefix cache for common prompts to reduce load: `config cache.prefix.enabled=true` on gateway
eng-runtime-dana: prefix cache toggled. also increasing connection pool timeout to 20s to avoid premature retires.
sre-charlie: good signal: 5xx now 1.6% and trending down. KV miss rate fell 30%.
cs-erin: posted a short update to the two customers acknowledging transient errors and that we're mitigating. link to internal status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/PD-78901
bob-sales: thanks — I'll tell the demo lead it's being addressed.
oncall-alice: PD-78901 auto-escalation suppressed; marking as acknowledged. preparing incident doc. tagging for postmortem if we cross 30m.
eng-runtime-dana: quick root-cause hypothesis: a sudden workload pattern broke our typical sequence-length distribution causing KV cache pressure and longer GPU kernel selection times on rw-large-4q. fallback model has smaller KV footprint and handled requests better.
sre-charlie: opened a short runbook checklist: 1) confirm rollback not needed (no deploy) 2) keep routing to fallback for next 15m 3) run sample synthetic prompts to validate stability 4) collect kernel-level profiles
oncall-alice: running synthetic ramp now (20 qps) to confirm stability
oncall-alice: synthetic run steady. 5xx ~0.2% baseline. will keep monitoring for 10m then start gradual rollback to primary variant.
eng-runtime-dana: added temporary alert: if 5xx>1% for 10m, auto-scale +4 and re-route to multi-region (failover to eu-west2)
sre-charlie: noted. logging all commands in PD ticket. scheduling a follow-up sync in #postmortems for 09:30 UTC tomorrow.
cs-erin: CS update sent to impacted customers: brief apology + explanation + expected timeline. no escalations so far.
oncall-alice: closing the Slack thread — PD incident remains acknowledged. tagging participants: @sre-charlie @eng-runtime-dana @cs-erin for follow-up postmortem.
pagerbot: PD-78901 status=acknowledged assignee=oncall-alice
sre-charlie: adding timeline and metrics snapshot to the incident doc.
eng-runtime-dana: note for follow-up: look into autoscaler tuning and kernel selection heuristics for rw-large-4q under skewed seq-length loads.
oncall-alice: thanks everyone. if anything regresses, re-open thread or page PD. :white_check_mark:
